resources.string: Use this phone’s screen lock to protect a recovery backup for the selected account. Android prepares the encrypted backup. Keep your screen lock private.
Allow an encrypted recovery backup for this account, protected by this phone’s screen lock? Setup may need you to lock and unlock the phone before you continue.
Check the saved setup with Google and continue its next step? If an earlier request is still uncertain, it stays saved for another check.
Close the saved setup? This does not undo a request Google already received or remove a recovery backup. The setup history remains protected on this phone.
Android is preparing the recovery backup. Lock and unlock this phone, then return here and continue setup.
The encrypted recovery backup is ready to send. Continue setup to save it with Google.
A setup request may have reached Google. Refresh to check its result.
Google confirmed the recovery backup. Continue setup to enable it for this account.
Google confirmed this account’s screen-lock recovery backup and recovery member.
Google no longer confirms this recovery setup. Close it before reviewing a new setup.
We could not confirm recovery setup. This phone needs recovery support and a connection to Google. Any saved setup remains available when you refresh.
